scope: Original provider artwork technical QA; independent of carrier and browser acceptance

engine.method: Original file bytes; fit/contain preserving aspect; alpha composite over declared background category. Neutral hex selected only for technical QA.

legal.officialProvenance: Source/official URLs and consultation claims present in input; no online revalidation in this FS-only audit.
legal.boundary: Technical safety/hash/render checks do not grant logo copyright, trademark, redistribution, affiliation or endorsement rights.

limitations: CairoSVG rasterization is not browser or Figma certification.
Unsupported filter primitives and text font environment dependencies, if any, are listed per asset.
CSS variable detection uses declarations internal to each SVG plus explicit fallbacks; context-dependent external CSS is rejected or recorded.
The two deliberately original raster SVG containers are accepted; no vector conversion/regeneration requested or performed.
Scaled native PNG references are checked as declared references, not asserted to be original-resolution artwork.
No new native/Figma imports or interactions were executed.
No screenshot contact sheet is claimed visually reviewed until the assistant actually opens it.
normalizations: React-to-standalone SVG attribute spelling and neutral backdrop selection are recorded in the brand manifest; geometry and paints remain unchanged.
